summary: The Survey Corps comes home exhausted, with hardening confirmed and the dead only partly recovered. The next departure points at the royal capital.

segments.ja: 調査兵団は、勝者の戻り方をしていません。馬は疲れ、翼のマークは泥で読めず、話される言葉の数は出発の朝より少ないです。エレンは敗者という言葉を、誰より先に自分へ置きます。女型の巨人を取り逃がし、仲間を返し、壁の内側へ運ばれた側です。敗者が自分だけなら、まだ軽い。列の全体が同じ語を着ていることが、今日の重さです。翼のマークは、勝利の印としては読めません。
segments.en: The Survey Corps is not coming back the way winners do. The horses are tired, mud has made the wings unreadable, and fewer words are spoken than on the morning they left. Eren puts the word defeated on himself before anyone else does. He is the one who let the Female Titan escape, failed to bring his comrades back, and was carried inside the walls. If only he were defeated, it would still be light. The weight today is that the whole column wears the same word. The wings do not read as victory.

segments.ja: 遠征の目的は、女型の巨人の捕獲でした。目的は達成されず、しかし消えてはいません。エルヴィンは失敗を、目的の取消とは扱いません。確認できた事実だけを、次の目標へ移します。敵は人間の技術を持つ。硬化する。情報を壁の内から受け取る。三つとも、死者の数より小さい文です。小さい文が、これからの作戦の芯になります。芯は、列の疲弊を癒しません。癒さない芯を、それでも次の頁に書きます。
segments.en: The expedition's objective was to capture the Female Titan. The objective was not achieved, and it has not disappeared. Erwin does not treat failure as a cancellation of the objective. He moves only the facts they could confirm onto the next goal. The enemy has human technique. It hardens. It receives information from inside the walls. All three are sentences smaller than the number of the dead. The small sentences become the core of the operation from here. The core does not heal the column's exhaustion. They write it on the next page anyway.

segments.ja: 森で見えたものの一つは、硬化です。女型の巨人は、刃を受ける部分を硬くできました。筋肉だけの巨人なら、うなじ以外も同じ脆さです。硬化は、その前提を破ります。エレンは自分の巨人化に、同じ能力があるかを知りません。知らないまま、敵だけがそれを持っている事実が残ります。ハンジが実験で知りたかった体の秘密の一つが、戦場で先に確認されました。確認の代償が、あまりに大きいです。大きい代償のあとでも、事実の欄は埋まります。
segments.en: One thing seen in the forest was hardening. The Female Titan could make the part that meets a blade hard. A Titan of muscle alone is equally fragile away from the nape. Hardening breaks that assumption. Eren does not know whether his own titanization has the same ability. While he does not know, the fact remains that only the enemy has it. One of the secrets of the body that Hange wanted from an experiment was confirmed first on a battlefield. The price of the confirmation is far too large. After it, the fact is still written down.

segments.ja: 撤退は、森を地図の外へ置いてきます。置いてきても、エレンの目はまだ巨木のあいだにあります。リヴァイが彼を回収した場所、特別作戦班が立っていた場所、女型の巨人が抜けた方向。場所はもう作戦の現在地ではありません。現在地は、壁の内側の移動です。エレンは現在地に意識を戻すのに、傷口の痛みより時間がかかります。痛みは体にあり、森は選択の記憶にあります。記憶の森は、地図から消えても目の奥に残ります。
segments.en: The retreat sets the forest outside the map. Even so, Eren's eyes are still among the giant trees. The place where Levi recovered him. The place where the squad stood. The direction the Female Titan slipped away. Those places are no longer the operation's present position. The present position is movement inside the walls. It takes Eren longer to bring his mind back to that position than the pain in his wounds takes. The pain is in the body. The forest is in the memory of a choice. It stays behind the eyes after it leaves the map.

segments.en: Soldiers whose deaths were confirmed should have gone onto the column of recovery. There was not space and time for every one of them. Petra, Eld, Oluo, Gunther. The word disposal is clerical, and the clerical tone is cruel. Eren is still counting, as people, the seats that were not recovered. Those seats do not climb back onto horses.

segments.en: Levi makes no speech of mourning. Care of wounds, assignment of horses, and under whose watch Eren will be placed. The practical work has become the reply to the dead. The Captain does not hide the exhaustion, and he does not stop. If he stopped, a delay in recovery would call the next death. Looking at that profile, Eren thinks it is the same person who did not slow down in the forest. Being the same is, today, both a rescue and a refusal to soften. That speed takes the living to the next gate.

segments.en: Some of the recruits see the exhaustion as the end of the Survey Corps. It is not the end. If it were, they would not be disposing of remains or assigning the next horses. segments.en: The royal capital is not a safe place for Eren. It is where the hearing was, and where his treatment becomes politics. Movement toward it looks both like protection and like an escort. Hardening breaks that assumption. Eren does not know whether his own titanization has the same ability. While he does not know, the fact remains that only the enemy has it. One of the secrets of the body that Hange wanted from an experiment was confirmed first on a battlefield. The price of the confirmation is far too large. After it, the fact is still written down.

vocab.exampleJa: 敗者の列は、外の巨人を悼む段階から、内の名前を疑う段階へ足をかけます。
vocab.exampleEn: Near the end of the movement, Eren hears the names Armin and Annie inside the same conversation. It is not a report of the forest. It is talk of a classmate. Someone has started laying the Female Titan's movements over movements seen in training. Eren cannot accept the overlap at once. The moment he accepts it, a comrade's face becomes the enemy's contents. The column of the defeated steps from mourning a Titan outside toward suspecting a name inside. The stepping foot has not yet taken the full weight. That happens in the next city.

vocab.exampleJa: 理解は、同意より遅いです。
vocab.exampleEn: The report they will carry to the royal capital will not be clean. Failed capture, death, missing, hardening, information passed from inside. There is not one word of victory in the vocabulary. Erwin does not improve the writing by adding what is not there. What is not there is the reason for the next operation. The reason can be correct and still not fill Petra's seat. Eren is beginning to understand that departing while looking at an unfilled seat is the manner of the defeated. Understanding comes later than agreement. The report closes first.

vocab.exampleJa: 女型の巨人を取り逃がし、仲間を返し、壁の内側へ運ばれた側です。
vocab.exampleEn: The Survey Corps is not coming back the way winners do. The horses are tired, mud has made the wings unreadable, and fewer words are spoken than on the morning they left. Eren puts the word defeated on himself before anyone else does. He is the one who let the Female Titan escape, failed to bring his comrades back, and was carried inside the walls. If only he were defeated, it would still be light. The weight today is that the whole column wears the same word. The wings do not read as victory.

vocab.exampleJa: エレンは現在地に意識を戻すのに、傷口の痛みより時間がかかります。
vocab.exampleEn: The retreat sets the forest outside the map. Even so, Eren's eyes are still among the giant trees. The place where Levi recovered him. The place where the squad stood. The direction the Female Titan slipped away. Those places are no longer the operation's present position. The present position is movement inside the walls. It takes Eren longer to bring his mind back to that position than the pain in his wounds takes. The pain is in the body. The forest is in the memory of a choice. It stays behind the eyes after it leaves the map.

vocab.exampleJa: 兵長は疲弊を隠さず、しかし停止もしません。
vocab.exampleEn: Levi makes no speech of mourning. Care of wounds, assignment of horses, and under whose watch Eren will be placed. The practical work has become the reply to the dead. The Captain does not hide the exhaustion, and he does not stop. If he stopped, a delay in recovery would call the next death. Looking at that profile, Eren thinks it is the same person who did not slow down in the forest. Being the same is, today, both a rescue and a refusal to soften. That speed takes the living to the next gate.

vocab.exampleEn: Soldiers whose deaths were confirmed should have gone onto the column of recovery. There was not space and time for every one of them. Petra, Eld, Oluo, Gunther. The word disposal is clerical, and the clerical tone is cruel. Eren is still counting, as people, the seats that were not recovered. Those seats do not climb back onto horses.
